items.required_rule: The production offline bridge must actually import the pinned installed polymarket-client 0.10.0 PublicClient and call its real PublicClient.search(q=...,page_size=...).first_page() over a MockTransport-backed gamma transport; prove real SDK method and typed SearchResults were reached. A fake replacing the SDK method or a hand-parsed substitute cannot pass.

items.required_rule: Use the v0.10.0 upstream-tested injected SyncTransport+httpx.MockTransport seam; strictly one bounded page and one request per case, no socket, no redirect, no implicit paging/retries, no credential or other method calls.
